title: Japan to beef up its defense with drones, AI and missiles, defense budget plans show
description: Japan’s Defense Ministry has disclosed details of an 8.9 trillion yen ($55.6 billion) budget request for the next fiscal year that officials say will increase significantly after the government adopts new security and defense plans later in the year. The budget outline released Monday focuses on drones, artificial intelligence and other new methods of warfare. The preliminary total is only a small increase from the 8.8 trillion yen ($55 billion) defense budget requested this fiscal year. It will be much higher eventually, but further details will come only after the new security and defense strategy is approved in December.
